claim: Markus Molitor's Klosterberg vinothek in Zeltingen-Rachtig is open daily 10:00-17:00.
quote: Our vinotheque is open daily from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

claim: Markus Molitor offers tastings of more than 40 wines at Haus Klosterberg in Bernkastel-Wehlen, by reservation.
quote: In the special atmosphere of the vinotheque at Klosterberg House... you can enjoy unique wine tastings, choosing your personal selection from more than 40 different wines.

claim: Weingut Dr. Loosen at St. Johannishof in Bernkastel-Kues is family-owned for over 200 years and led by Ernst Loosen, specialising in great Rieslings.
quote: Family-owned for over 200 years, the winery combines a rich tradition with a clear vision for the highest quality.

claim: Dr. Loosen tastings (1-40 people, German/English) are by appointment Mon-Sat 10:00-17:00 in high season; closed Sundays.
quote: We are in the high season for wine tastings and wine purchases from Monday to Saturday between 10 AM and 5 PM by appointment. On Sundays and public holidays, the wine shop is closed.

claim: Weingut Schloss Lieser, led by Thomas Haag (Winzer des Jahres 2015), works eight VDP.Grosse Lage sites including Brauneberger Juffer Sonnenuhr, Wehlener Sonnenuhr and Bernkasteler Doctor.
quote: Thomas Haag won the title Winzer des Jahres (Winemaker of the Year) in 2015 and achieved the fifth grape, the highest category in both the Gault Millau and Eichelmann wine guides.

claim: Schloss Lieser is a VDP member estate in the Mosel region.
J.J. Prüm in Wehlen, founded 1911 and now led by Dr Katharina Prüm, farms 13.5 ha of vines exclusively planted to Riesling on slate slopes.
quote: The estate is run by Dr Katharina Prüm who watches over 13.5 hectares of vines... Only Riesling is grown and harvested there.

claim: Joh. Jos. Prüm is a VDP estate; visits and tastings are by advance appointment.
Weingut Fritz Haag in Brauneberg farms 19.5 ha including 8 ha in the Grosse Lage Juffer and Juffer Sonnenuhr sites with slopes to 80%.
quote: The vineyards cover 19.5 hectares of vines with slopes of up to 80%, eight hectares of which are in the top Brauneberg sites of Juffer and Juffer Sonnenuhr.

claim: The Juffer-Sonnenuhr is the steepest, most south-facing portion of the Brauneberg hillside and produces Fritz Haag's flagship Grosse Lage wines.
quote: The Juffer-Sonnenuhr vineyard is the steepest and most south-facing part of the Brauneberg hillside, surrounded by the Juffer vineyard, and this Grosse Lage (Grand Cru) site produces profound, distinctive wines with great purity and concentration.

claim: Selbach-Oster in Zeltingen-Rachtig (Gänsfelder Straße 20) offers Riesling tastings by request, except during harvest until end of October.
quote: Wine tastings are gladly possible upon request. Wine tastings are not available during the harvest (until about the end of October).

claim: Moselsteig Stage 10 (Kesten/Osann-Monzel to Bernkastel-Kues) crosses the Brauneberger Juffer vineyard with views from Monzeler Kätzchen and ends at Landshut Castle above Bernkastel.
quote: The trail passes impressive rocky cliffs with splendid visible layers of slate and crosses world-renowned vineyards, such as Braunberger Juffer.

claim: Moselsteig Stage 11 continues from Bernkastel-Kues through the Wehlener Sonnenuhr and Ürziger Würzgarten vineyards toward Ürzig.
The Wine Festival of the Middle Mosel runs 3-7 September 2026 in Bernkastel-Kues with a wine route, Saturday fireworks and Sunday parade.
quote: Wine festival of the Middle Mosel in Bernkastel-Kues 03.09.2026

claim: The Middle Moselle Wine Festival features a 300-metre wine route with 20+ vendors and adds guided wine hikes new for 2026.
quote: Wine Route - a 300-meter stretch with over 20 wine vendors offering 'Riesling and other types of wine'... Special wine hiking tours (new for 2026)

claim: The Brauneberg Wine Festival runs 4-7 June 2026 at Moselweinstraße 101 with three local wineries (Fehres, Heil, Boujong) and live music.
quote: Dates: June 4-7, 2026, starting at 11:00 AM each day... Three renowned wineries participate—Harald Konrad Fehres, Rainer Heil, and Boujong

claim: Mythos Mosel 2026 (29-31 May) brings 116 winegrowers to 29 stations between Kesten and Zeltingen-Rachtig with shuttle buses from Mülheim; tickets €60 Saturday, €30 Sunday.
quote: Overall, 116 winegrowers will present their wines at 29 stations between Kesten and Zeltingen-Rachtig... Tickets are only available in advance, €60 on Saturday and €30 on Sunday.

claim: The Brauneberger Juffer slope reaches 80% gradient and has been a top site since Roman times, with Napoleon pricing its wines above all other Mosel wines.
quote: The riverbank opposite Brauneberg is a steep, south-facing slope that reaches a gradient of 80 percent... Napoleon paid tribute to the Brauneberger wines by fixing their prices above those of all other Mosel wines.
